test_title: PYST 18 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 19 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain coded language 'BRIO' is coded as 'FVMS' and 'DRAB' is coded as 'HVEF'. How will 'ATOP' be coded in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3163faaddc0af7bd77f81444e45afbc5ffb16297bcb1e3c962870baffc3df5d5.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: Each letter is shifted **+4 positions forward** in the alphabet.

Here,

BRIO → FVMS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1f218c33832acfc8be3bbb36f638144e3a134a8b1825e7c34baff66ad1b9040.png] 

DRAB → HVEF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0f69c8d91bccb485c024fae3cdd118ee4213c59d132273406929c636b93f4f6.png] 

Now apply the same to **ATOP**:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3eac2cef62d93227f4148de7446c5b4f40201a3c676fdfb39c39ea4f2aee4f29.png] 

So, the code becomes **EXST**

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
